evals.prompt: put our status dashboard at https://status.example.com on the big screen
evals.expected_output: The dashboard cast to a screen as a live web page, with a confirmation naming the screen.
assertions: Passes the URL unchanged as content
Reports which screen the cast landed on
Does not call cast_file for a URL that is already reachable

evals.prompt: here's the Q3 deck, throw it up on screen 2 — ~/decks/q3.pptx
evals.expected_output: The PowerPoint uploaded and cast on screen 2, paging like a deck.
assertions: Reads the file and calls cast_file with base64 data
Does not attempt to cast a local filesystem path as a url
Mentions that the deck can be paged through

evals.expected_output: The casted deck advances one page.
assertions: Does not ask which screen when only one cast is active

evals.prompt: the text on screen is tiny, can you make it bigger
evals.expected_output: The cast zoomed in a step.
All screens stopped and returned to standby.
assertions: Omits the screen argument, or stops every screen

evals.prompt: show a countdown that says 'Doors open at 7pm' on the lobby screen
evals.expected_output: The text cast to a screen.
assertions: Passes the message itself as content, not a URL
Does not invent a screen number without checking device_status first, or asks which screen the lobby is

should_trigger: cast this pdf to the tv
show the grafana board on screen 1
play this youtube clip on the big screen
put these photos up in the lobby
what's on the screens right now
zoom in a bit on the screen
display a message saying we're back at 2pm

take a screenshot of my laptop
open this page in my browser
start a coding agent on the device
click the sign-in button on the casted page
